column3: Corruption cases are actually ending in court convictions.

column1: What did the President do when the humanitarian ministry scandal broke?
column2: He suspended the minister within weeks (January 2024) and ordered an EFCC probe, which recovered ₦32.7bn plus $445,000.
column3: Even his own minister wasn't shielded.

column1: What did the President order after fake agencies were uncovered?
column2: A full forensic audit of the government payroll (IPPIS) and the legal status of federal agencies (August 2026), plus suspensions and an arrest.
column3: Fixing the system so ghost workers and fake agencies can't hide.
